results.note: Humbert of Silvacandida's 'Adversus Graecorum calumnias' (Against the Slanders of the Greeks, 1053). No English translation located despite searches.
Humbert of Silvacandida's 'Adversus Simoniacos' (Three Books Against the Simoniacs, 1057). Scholarly editions exist in Latin; no English translation found.
Humbert of Silvacandida's 'Commemoratio eorum quae gesserunt apocrisarii' (brief work, 1029 words). No English translation located.
Humbert of Silvacandida's 'Contra Nicetam'. No English translation found in available sources.
Jonas of Orléans' 'De cultu imaginum' (On the Veneration of Images, three books). No English translation found; Manchester University Press translation project mentioned but status unclear.
Jonas of Orléans' 'De institutione laicali' (Lay instruction for Count Matfrid). Search results indicate Manchester University Press has a translation project in progress; completion status unknown.
Jonas of Orléans' 'De institutione regia' (Royal instruction). No English translation located despite searches of Carolingian reform literature.
Jonas of Orléans' 'Historia translationis S. Hucberti' (History of the translation/relocation of Saint Hubert's relics). No English translation found.
Justinian I's 'Adversus Origenem' (Against Origen). Work exists primarily in Greek/Latin; no English translation located despite searches of Origenist controversy sources.
Justinian I's 'Epistola' (Letter/letters). No specific English translation of Justinian's epistles from PL 69 found despite searches of Migne collections.
Justinian I's 'Leges selectae' (Selected laws). No specific English translation of this selection located; general Justinian law translations exist but not this particular compilation.

Justinian I's 'Novellae selectae' (Selected Novels/laws). Complete English translation: The Novels of Justinian, annotated and translated by David J.D. Miller, ed. Peter Sarris (Cambridge University Press, 2 vols, 2018).
Peter Lombard's 'Collectanea in epistolas Pauli 1' (Gloss on Paul's letters, vol 1). No English translation located; exists in Latin PL 191:1297–1696.

Peter Lombard's 'Commentaria in Psalmos' (Commentary on the Psalms, 535,663 words). Only the preface translated to English in Medieval Literary Theory and Criticism (Minnis & Scott, 1988); full translation not located.
Peter Lombard's 'Collectanea in epistolas Pauli 2' (Gloss on Paul's letters, vol 2). No English translation located; continues work from vol 1 in PL 192:9–520.

Peter Lombard's 'Sententiae' (Four Books of Sentences). All four books translated by Giulio Silano, Pontifical Institute of Mediaeval Studies (PIMS), 2007–2010: Books 1-4 in Medieval Sources in Translation series.
Adam of Perseigne's 'Epistolae' (Letters). English translation by Grace Perigo with introduction by Thomas Merton, Cistercian Fathers Series vol. 21, Gorgias Press (2010).
Adam of Perseigne's 'Fragmenta Mariana' (Marian fragments, 4,152 words). No English translation located.
Adam of Perseigne's 'Mariale' (Marian sermons, 12 sermons, 18,300 words). No complete English translation found; works have been translated to French (Thomas, 1963) but not English.
Auctor incertus (Isidorus Hispalensis?) 'Carmina' (Poems, 1,009 words). Attributed possibly to Isidore of Seville but uncertain; no English translation located.

Auctor incertus (Isidorus Hispalensis?) 'Liber glossarum' (Book of glosses, 5,888 words). Vast medieval encyclopedic glossary from 7th-century Visigothic Spain. No English translation found despite digital edition (Grondeux & Cinato, 2016).
Auctor incertus (Isidorus Hispalensis?) 'Liber canonum' (Book of canons, 25,894 words). Possibly by or attributed to Isidore; no English translation located despite searches.

Auctor incertus (Liutprandus Cremonensis?) 'De pontificum Romanorum vitis' (Lives of Roman Popes, 39,692 words). Possibly included in The Complete Works of Liudprand of Cremona trans. Paolo Squatriti (CUA Press, Medieval Texts in Translation), though authorship uncertain.

Auctor incertus (Liutprandus Cremonensis?) 'Adversaria' (Miscellaneous notes, 15,159 words). Marked as spurious in scholarly literature; not confirmed as Liutprand's authentic work. No English translation located.

Auctor incertus (Liutprandus Cremonensis?) 'Chronicon' (Chronicle, 10,360 words). Possibly included in The Complete Works of Liudprand of Cremona trans. Paolo Squatriti (CUA Press); authorship attribution uncertain.

Auctor incertus (Maximus Taurinensis?) 'Homiliae' (Homilies, 1,950 words). Likely attributable to or confused with Maximus of Turin. Sermons of St. Maximus of Turin translated by Boniface Ramsey (Ancient Christian Writers 50, 1989).

Auctor incertus (Maximus Taurinensis?) 'Sermones' (Sermons, 33,981 words). Likely part of Maximus of Turin's corpus. The Sermons of St. Maximus of Turin translated by Boniface Ramsey (Ancient Christian Writers 50, 1989).

Auctor incertus (Maximus Taurinensis?) 'Epistolae' (Letters, 17,890 words). If attributed to Maximus of Turin, it would be outside the main sermons corpus (which typically contains 100+ homilies and sermons). Distinct translation not located.

Auctor incertus (Rabanus Maurus?) 'Allegoriae in universam sacram scripturam' (Allegories in all Holy Scripture, 85,900 words). Complete English translation by Priscilla Throop (MedievalMS, 2nd edn. 2012).
Auctor incertus (Rabanus Maurus?) 'Carmina dubia et spuria' (Doubtful and spurious poems, 2,104 words). No English translation located.
Auctor incertus (Rabanus Maurus?) 'Fragmentum glossarii Latino Theotisci' (Fragment of a Latin-Old High German glossary, 11 words). Minimal text; no English translation expected or found.

Auctor incertus (Walafridus Strabo?) 'Expositio in quatuor Evangelia' (Exposition on the Four Gospels, 23,135 words). If attributed to Walafrid Strabo, ascription is uncertain. No English translation located despite searches.
Auctor incertus (Walafridus Strabo?) 'Threni' (Laments, 38 words). Minimal text; no English translation located.

Auctor incertus (Walafridus Strabo?) 'Vita S. Leodegarii' (Life of Saint Leodegarius, 7,375 words). If attributed to Walafrid Strabo, ascription is uncertain. No English translation located despite searches.
Balduinus Cantuariensis's 'De commendatione fidei' (In Praise of Faith, 28,205 words). No English translation located; manuscript editions noted in Stanford Digital Collections.
Balduinus Cantuariensis's 'De sacramento altaris' (On the Sacrament of the Altar, 54,473 words). Published in Sources Chrétiennes vols. 93-94 (1963); no English translation located.
Balduinus Cantuariensis's 'Tractatus diversi' (Diverse treatises, 69,402 words). Collections of his theological works; no English translation of this compilation located.
Bonizo Placentinus's 'De persecutione ecclesiae' (On the Persecution of the Church, 19,646 words). Medieval Gregorian Reform polemic; no English translation located despite searches.
Bonizo Placentinus's 'De sacramentis' (On the Sacraments, 3,054 words). No English translation located.
Bonizo Placentinus's 'Fragmentum historiae pontificiae' (Fragment of papal history, 1,850 words). No English translation located.

Fredegarius Scholasticus Burgundiae's 'Chronicum' (Chronicle, 22,296 words). Partial English translation: The Fourth Book of the Chronicle of Fredegar with its Continuations, trans. J.M. Wallace-Hadrill (1960, Medieval Classics series). Latin-English facing pages.
Fredegarius Scholasticus Burgundiae's 'Fragmenta de historia Francorum' (Fragments of Frankish history, 1,820 words). Covered by Wallace-Hadrill's partial translation (1960) of the Fourth Book.

Fredegarius Scholasticus Burgundiae's 'Historia Francorum epitomata' (Epitome of Frankish history, 8,972 words). English translation in dissertation by Jane Ellen Woodruff (1987): 'An Annotated Translation and Historical Analysis of Interpolated Material'.
